answer.line: Paragraph 9, sentence 4: the MAC of nitrous oxide is slightly more than a whole atmosphere, so it cannot carry an anaesthetic alone.

steps: Put each number next to its agent. Paragraph 9, sentences 3 and 4.
Isoflurane a little over 1 percent, sevoflurane about 2 percent, desflurane about 6 percent, xenon about two thirds of a breath. All under one atmosphere.
Only nitrous oxide passes the line: slightly more than a whole atmosphere.

choices.note: Isoflurane is a little over 1 percent of the breath, the smallest figure in the list.
Sevoflurane is about 2 percent, far below a whole atmosphere.
Desflurane has the biggest number among the volatile agents, about six. The unit carries over from the list: about 6 percent, not six atmospheres.
Xenon is the real runner-up: about two thirds of the breath. Large, and still less than a whole atmosphere.
Slightly more than a whole atmosphere: the only MAC in the paragraph above one.
